statement: He has no strong opinion on this week's balance options; AFK gain is fine.
Cash balance option is less fine than the others.
Sailing EXP balance option is all right for all stages of the game; choose what you want.
All stat won last week; it is additive and trash.

There is more to prep but these are some of the quicker wins.
Stalk value three is top tier on the exotic market; it is the only source of crop value and a major buff to harvested crops.
Bro legumes two for bean multi is in the second exotic market tier.
Betanite two for night market upgrade cost reduction is in the second tier.
Evergrow one for overgrow chance is in the second tier.
Stable root two for land rank EXP is in the second tier.
Leg mi? for extra beans is also in the second tier.
Prisma pestle is an honorable mention in the same tier as the second-tier picks.
Get prisma pestle to around 1000 for over 1%; it stacks with other additive prisma bubble sources.
Don't invest in prisma pestle past ~1000 as diminishing returns kick in; the top end is 2%.
Better day one is last: day market is terrible as an additive bonus and investing is polishing a turd.
Two of this week's packs are top five on his list; best friend Bubba is the first.
Event plays in the best friend Bubba pack are fine.
Bubba buffs the strongest single mechanic in the game by 30%; more with its plus pet variant.
Skip the Bubba pack if you can trade for it; otherwise it is head and shoulders above the competition.
Event plays in autumn breeze are whatever.
Chippy in autumn breeze is solid with a 2x EXP multi and some damage; nothing to write home about.
Autumn breeze account bonus is one of the strongest in the game: 2x statues and gold food as a true multi.
Example: 10x statue drops become 20x with the 2x bonus; a key reason end gamers get filthy cluster drops.
Paradise pack hat rack multi is fantastic given how many great bonuses are in the hat rack.
Ribbons daily is the most time-gated mechanic of all time and is incredibly solid.
All three packs this week are worth your time if you are interested in the pay-to-win side.
Weekly boss SWR needs the mammoth code plugged in to take it out; codes are on screen.
Miscellaneous run nets two trophies and 60% class EXP and 20% bonus damage.
Extra weekly boss damage comes from Chocky kills and construction and cooking levels.
A step-by-step tutorial for completing the Chocky mechanic is in his most recent daily video.
Decent week in the chip repository; grounded software isn't worth talking about.
Wood chip is a solid filler chip for your characters.
Pure opal nugget is a 16% multi to effectively the entire lab stand's Spelunca opal; extremely powerful.
Missed pure opals are picked up automatically when reaching certain account lab level breakpoints.
